# LFG Dubai

> LFG Dubai (Lift. Focus. Grind.) is one of Dubai's fastest-growing running clubs, with a community of 1000+ members. It runs free weekly group runs, a paid Sunday bootcamp, and private performance coaching. Founded by coach Ahmed Sam.

## What LFG is
- A running club and fitness community based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
- Open to all levels, from first-time runners to experienced athletes.
- Members join for the weekly group runs, the Sunday bootcamp, and the community.

## Weekly schedule
- Group run: every Wednesday at 7:30 PM (Dubai).
- Group run: every Saturday at 6:30 AM (Dubai).
- Sunday Bootcamp: 12:45 PM at CrossFit Alioth, Dubai. 60 minutes, four stations, scaled to your level. First session 99 AED, with cheaper credit packs.

## How to join
- Joining the weekly runs is free. Members join through the WhatsApp flow on the website and get the meeting point and route for the next run.
- A free account on the website is used to book bootcamp spots, check in at sessions with a QR code, track attendance and leaderboard points, and manage bookings.

## Coaching
- Ahmed Sam, founder of LFG Dubai, offers online coaching through LFG Coaching: personal training programs, nutrition plans, and weekly check-ins in the LFG Coaching app.
- Packages and pricing: https://coaching.lfgdubai.com/packages
- Book a free 30-minute consultation call: https://coaching.lfgdubai.com/book

## Merchandise
- The LFG Tee: a PUMA-branded tee with the LFG crest, black on black, AED 150. Picked up at the next run.
